sourcePolicyEstimator.serializedBytes: UTF-8 bytes of one JsonSerializer source-fact object; pack stop resource
sourcePolicyEstimator.estimatedInputTokens: ceil(serializedBytes / 6.0); deterministic conservative proxy, not provider tokenization
sourcePolicyEstimator.exactInputTokens: not available provider-free; never conflated with estimatedInputTokens
sourcePolicyEstimator.ownedAtomCount: number of source occurrences in OWNED_CORE
sourcePolicyEstimator.visibleAtomCount: number of source occurrences in LEFT_HALO + OWNED_CORE + RIGHT_HALO
sourcePolicyEstimator.completionReserveTokens: reserved completion allowance included in the estimated-token stop condition

contextBudget.explanation: The 40,000-token context limit is a provider-envelope ceiling; the policy uses a 20,000-token estimated input ceiling and reserves 12,288 completion tokens, so the source stop is intentionally below the context maximum.

composerMeasurement.serializedBytes: UTF-8 bytes of complete system + user request after canonical composer
composerMeasurement.estimatedInputTokens: ceil(complete UTF-8 request bytes / 6.0), reporting proxy only
composerMeasurement.explanation: A 20,000 estimated source-token ceiling can yield a ~28,862-byte complete request because source-fact bytes are divided by six, completion reserve is included, and the complete request adds system/schema/JSON overhead.
